topic: English keyword universe for MobilCube Google Ads (Montreal anglophone market: West Island, downtown, NDG, Westmount, Lachine, Vaudreuil-Hudson, anglophone South Shore)
summary: English is a real but secondary market for MobilCube: Statistics Canada's 2021 census counts 867,685 people whose first official language spoken (FOLS) is English in the Montréal CMA (20.4% of 4,246,065) plus 284,025 (6.7%) 'English and French'; the standard FOLS derivation (English + half of 'both') gives ~23.8%, which validates the ~20-25% planning assumption. That English demand is geographically concentrated: English FOLS is 65-68% in Dollard-Des Ormeaux (31,455 of 48,200), Pointe-Claire (22,130 of 33,000), Beaconsfield (12,890 of 19,110), Kirkland (13,095 of 19,385) and Westmount (13,250 of 19,445), so English campaigns should be geo-targeted to those municipalities plus NDG, Lachine, Vaudreuil-Hudson and Greenfield Park/Saint-Lambert rather than run CMA-wide. No keyword tool with Canadian volumes was reachable in this session (Parallel Search rate-limited, Google Keyword Planner requires an account), so every monthly volume below is an ESTIMATE built from US Ahrefs anchors (storage units near me 445,000; self storage near me 82,000; RV storage 33,000; boat storage 30,000, pulled 2026-03-02 per StoragePug) scaled to the Montreal English-FOLS pool (~1.0M people, ~0.30% of the US population) and adjusted for seasonality; CPCs are ranges in CAD derived from published USD benchmarks (LocalIQ 2026: Home & Home Improvement $8.33, Business Services $5.87, Industrial & Commercial $5.87, Automotive Repair/Service $4.35, Real Estate $3.22; self-storage $3.80 average and $4-15 in dense metros; a Vancouver container-rental niche at $3) converted at an assumed 1.37 CAD/USD. The English universe splits into four clusters: (A) mobile/portable storage core terms where PODS, Cubeit, U-Haul U-Box and GoCube compete and CPCs are highest (est. 5-11 CAD); (B) winter vehicle storage terms (car, classic car, motorcycle, boat, ATV, trailer) with strong Sep-Nov seasonality and cheaper clicks (est. 2.50-7 CAD) where competitors are self-storage chains (Depotium, Public Storage Canada) and marinas, and PODS Montreal explicitly sells 'winter car storage'; (C) commercial/seasonal terms (patio furniture, restaurant terrace, business inventory, jobsite) with very low English volume but high B2B value (est. 6-13 CAD); (D) competitor brand terms. Google's Trademarks policy does not restrict trademark use as keywords, so bidding on 'pods montreal', 'cubeit', 'gocube', 'u-box' and 'bigsteelbox' is permitted, but those marks must not appear in ad text (only resellers/informational sites are exempted), and Google will act on complaints from trademark owners in countries where they hold rights, including Canada. Negative keywords do not match close variants, so plurals/misspellings must be listed explicitly; the 100+ item English negative list below covers product confusion (bins, sheds, deck boxes), tech storage (cloud, iPhone, GB), buy-vs-rent (for sale, sea can, 40 ft), jobs, adjacent services (movers, truck rental, marinas) and geo confusion (Kirkland WA, Hudson NY, Ontario).

findings.claim: English is roughly 20-24% of the Montréal CMA, concentrated in the West Island and Westmount.
findings.detail: 2021 census FOLS for Montréal CMA: English 867,685 (20.4%), French 3,028,175 (71.3%), both 284,025 (6.7%), neither 66,180 (1.6%); total 4,246,065. English + half of 'both' = 1,009,698 = 23.8%. Municipal FOLS (English count / total of four categories): Dollard-Des Ormeaux 31,455/48,200 = 65%; Pointe-Claire 22,130/33,000 = 67%; Beaconsfield 12,890/19,110 = 67%; Kirkland 13,095/19,385 = 68%; Westmount 13,250/19,445 = 68%.

findings.claim: No Canadian keyword-volume dataset was obtainable; all volumes are modelled estimates and must be validated in Google Keyword Planner (location: Montréal CMA, language: English) before launch.
findings.detail: Parallel Search MCP hit its free-tier rate limit on the first call and the WebSearch budget (200) was exhausted mid-task; Semrush/SE Ranking free checkers are JS apps not readable here. US anchors (Ahrefs, pulled 2026-03-02, monthly US searches): 'storage units near me' 445,000; 'self storage near me' 82,000; 'RV storage' 33,000; 'boat storage' 30,000. Scaling factor used: Montreal English-FOLS pool ~1.01M / US ~335M = 0.30%, then adjusted up for Montreal's winter-storage seasonality and down for terms with low English share.

findings.claim: Published CPC benchmarks put relevant categories at USD 3.22-8.33 per click (2026), with self-storage specifically at USD ~3.80 average and USD 4-15 in dense metros.
findings.detail: LocalIQ 2026 search benchmarks (published 2026-06-01, USD): Real Estate CPC $3.22 / CVR 3.70% / CPL $102.51; Business Services $5.87 / 4.85% / $93.69; Home & Home Improvement $8.33 / 8.05% / $90.92; Automotive Repair, Service & Parts $4.35 / 15.51% / $29.96; Industrial & Commercial $5.87 / 8.20% / $75.19; all-industry avg CPC $5.42, CVR 8.18%, CPL $66.69. Self-storage: ~$3.80 average CPC (BlogBuster 2025); $4-15/click for 'self storage near me'/'storage units [city]' in dense metros (StorIQ); Inside Self-Storage (2025-05-28) cites $10-40/click in the most contested US markets. Salt Water Digital (2024-09-24) documented a Vancouver container niche ('flat pack storage container') at 500 searches/mo, $3 CPC, $30 cost/conversion. Canadian CPCs are typically below US; an assumed 1.37 CAD/USD conversion is used in the tables (assumption, not sourced).

findings.claim: Google permits bidding on competitor trademarks as keywords but restricts them in ad text; trademark owners can file complaints for countries where they hold rights.
findings.detail: Google Ads Trademarks policy: 'Google does not restrict trademark use' as keywords or in the second-level domain of a display URL; restrictions apply to trademarks in ad text used by competitors or 'in a confusing, deceptive, or misleading way'; exceptions for reseller sites (landing page primarily dedicated to selling the trademarked product with commercial info) and informational sites; complaints are accepted 'within the countries and industries in which trademark owners have demonstrated trademark rights'. Practical rule for MobilCube: keywords 'pods', 'cubeit', 'gocube', 'u-box', 'bigsteelbox' are allowed; never place these words in headlines/descriptions/sitelinks/display path; avoid 'PODS' even generically in copy (use 'storage container', 'storage cube'). Canadian courts have not settled keyword-bidding liability; industry commentary notes liability turns on likelihood of confusion, so keep copy clearly MobilCube-branded.

findings.claim: Competitor English presence in Montreal: PODS, Cubeit, U-Haul U-Box and GoCube are active; BigSteelBox has no Quebec location.
findings.detail: PODS Montreal page (pods.ca) sells 8', 12', 16' containers, 'portable container'/'moving container' wording, and 'Winter car storage: keep your car warm and clean all winter long in one of our safe, heated facilities'; no price shown, phone (855) 706-4758. Cubeit: 8x8x16 ft container, Quebec locations Montreal, Longueuil, Boucherville, Brossard, Laval, Gatineau; 'Free local delivery in all markets' within 25 km, valid through 2026-09-30; phone 1-844-897-3811; no vehicle storage. U-Haul U-Box: 8'x5'x7.6' container ('fits about a room and a half'), offered at Montréal-Ouest, Montréal-Nord, Centre-Ville (2000 Notre-Dame E), Crémazie Ouest and other Montreal centres. GoCube: 5x8x7 ft cube, 'storage cube', 'mobile storage', 'cube rental' wording, from $95/month (3 cubes x 5 months, transport excluded), 30% off 2+ cubes promo valid before 2026-03-31, 514-738-6843, serves Montreal + South & North Shore, no vehicle storage. BigSteelBox: 8', 10', 20' containers, 'from $484-$834' for a 1-month 20' rental incl. delivery/pickup (MovingWaldo, updated 2026-02-25), but locations page lists no Quebec store (Ottawa is easternmost).

findings.claim: Montreal winter car storage market prices seen: $150-$200/month indoor with 4-5 month minimums; Sentinel (Hwy 40, West Island) described by users as overpriced.
findings.detail: Kijiji Greater Montréal car-storage listings: St-Leonard indoor garage $160/month, 5-month minimum; Ville St-Laurent indoor garage $200/month, 4-month minimum; secure heated spots at $150. Rennlist forum thread (Porsche owners) names Sentinel on Hwy 40 as 'overpriced'. Depotium and Public Storage Canada run dedicated 'Car Storage Montreal' / 'Winter Boat Storage in Montreal' / Dorval pages but show no price in the fetched content (not_found). MobilCube's only public prices: Advantage 'up to $180/month' (with commitment) and Freedom '$350/month' (no commitment).

findings.claim: Google negative keywords do not match close variants, so plurals, misspellings and synonyms must be added explicitly; match types are meaning-based.
findings.detail: Negative keyword help: 'Negative keywords won't match to close variants or other expansions'; negative match types are broad (all terms, any order), phrase (exact sequence), exact (whole query). Keyword match types: broad = searches related to the keyword (may not contain its meaning); phrase = searches that include the meaning; exact = same meaning or intent. Implication: keep positive keywords in phrase/exact for launch, and list both 'storage bin' and 'storage bins', 'shed' and 'sheds', etc. in negatives.

findings.claim: Self-storage PPC practitioners recommend exact-match launches and negatives for product/tote confusion, truck rental and jobs.
findings.detail: StoragePug (2026-07-01) recommends starting with exact match so 'storage containers' (plastic totes) searches don't trigger ads and uploading a customer-match exclusion list. Inside Self-Storage (2025-05-28) recommends negatives 'moving truck rental', 'jobs', 'careers', 'free' and keyword themes 'moving storage', 'business storage', 'climate-controlled storage', 'RV storage'. StorIQ notes self-storage buyers search within a 3-5 mile radius, supporting municipality-level geo bids for English.

findings.claim: Terminology differs by competitor and should be mirrored in ad groups: 'portable storage container' (PODS/Cubeit/U-Haul), 'moving container' (PODS/U-Box/BigSteelBox), 'storage cube' (GoCube, and MobilCube's own brand), 'mobile storage' (GoCube/MobilCube).
findings.detail: U-Haul SERP titles: 'Portable Storage & Moving Containers Near Montreal, QC'; PODS: 'portable container', 'moving container'; Cubeit: 'portable storage containers'; GoCube: 'storage cube', 'cube rental', 'mobile storage', 'removal container'; MobilCube EN homepage: 'mobile storage', 'container', 'unit', '160 sq. ft.', '20 feet of CORTEN steel', 'Rent. Store at your place or ours.'

recommendations: Structure English search as 4 campaigns: EN-Core Mobile Storage (cluster A), EN-Vehicle Winter (cluster B, budget-weighted Sep 26-Nov 30), EN-Commercial Seasonal (cluster C, small budget + call-only ads, weekdays 8-18h), EN-Competitor (cluster D, separate campaign with its own low CPA target and no trademark words in copy).

Geo-target English campaigns to municipalities with >50% English FOLS (Pointe-Claire, Beaconsfield, Kirkland, DDO, Baie-D'Urfé, Senneville, Hudson, Westmount, Montreal West, Hampstead, Côte-Saint-Luc, Greenfield Park/Saint-Lambert) plus NDG/Lachine/Vaudreuil radius, and set language targeting to English only; run the rest of the CMA in the French campaigns. Apply bid adjustments (+15-25%) on West Island and Westmount for vehicle-storage ad groups.

Launch with phrase + exact only; reserve broad match for a single 'self storage alternative delivered' test ad group with Smart Bidding once >30 conversions/month exist. Import the full negative list at account level on day 1 (Google negatives do not catch plurals/close variants, so keep both singular and plural).

Validate every estimated volume/CPC in Google Keyword Planner (location Montréal CMA, language English, 12-month history) before setting budgets; treat the tables here as prioritisation, not forecasts. Re-forecast after the first 14 days using actual search-term reports.

Vehicle ad copy: lead with 'heated, secure facility', 'from $X/month' (only if a real vehicle price is set — the site currently shows Advantage 'up to $180/month' and Freedom '$350/month' for the cube, not a vehicle rate), and a fit qualifier ('cars, motorcycles, ATVs, PWCs, small boats/trailers up to 20 ft') to filter RV/large-boat clicks; add 'rv', 'motorhome', 'camper' and 'pontoon' as negatives unless MobilCube confirms outdoor yard parking.

Commercial cluster: English volume is tiny (est. <20/mo per term), so bid aggressively on exact terms ('restaurant patio furniture storage', 'business storage montreal', 'commercial storage container rental montreal') with a dedicated B2B landing page and call extension; complement with Meta/LinkedIn targeting of restaurant/hotel managers rather than expecting search volume.

Competitor campaign: bid on 'pods montreal', 'cubeit', 'gocube', 'u-box', 'bigsteelbox montreal' at low max CPC (est. 1.50-5 CAD); headline angle 'Delivered storage cube — price shown online, book in 60 seconds' exploits PODS' quote-only pricing and BigSteelBox's absence from Quebec. Expect low Quality Score (3-5) and cap spend at ~10% of English budget.

Mirror competitor terminology in ad groups and RSAs: separate ad groups for 'portable storage container', 'moving container', 'storage pod', 'storage cube', 'mobile storage' so headlines echo the query; always include 'Montreal' or the municipality in Headline 1-2 for geo terms.

Use seasonal budget pacing: cluster B spend should start now (late Sept) and taper after mid-November; cluster A moving-container terms peak May-July (Quebec July 1 moving day) — keep evergreen at a lower budget through winter; snowmobile/tire terms return in April.

Track calls as conversions (call extension + website call tracking) since the client's goal is phone calls; use LocalIQ 2026 benchmarks (CVR 4.85-8.20%, CPL USD 75-94 for Business/Industrial; CPL USD 29.96 for Automotive services) as initial CPA guardrails until MobilCube's own data accrues.
